findings.evidence: ENG-2 and the user-changes fix rule: every behaviour-changing fix needs a Red: line. The commit body carries seven Red: lines (symlink, glob, read cap, index shape, commands, worktree commit, adoption name) but none names test_ref_starting_with_a_dash_is_rejected. The fix is instructions.py resolve_ref `if ref.startswith("-"): raise ScanError(...)`. The commit subject-body line lists SEC-4 among the fixes.
